record.title: Choose stock loader validation or one measured file-access fixture correction
record.intent: Use actual application-domain access to select the next bounded transition.
requirements: Compare actual process identity file operations and audit evidence with the static prediction; do not equate root-shell roundtrip success with stock-domain readability.

If access is supported admit the bounded first-three-stock-loader experiment; if denied inspect the exact failing object and existing policy before proposing one narrow research fixture correction and corresponding controls.
Treat an unexpected process domain certificate mismatch or missing observation as a distinct no-go; preserve original artifacts and current policy rather than adapting the experiment in place.
Draft plan inspect admit and commit successor tasking before execution; keep every model response explicit and avoid physical instrument or host policy changes.
acceptance: Commit and push an evidence-supported continuation decision.
